findings.source_quote: Together the girls bowed their heads and pled for the Lord’s protection and help.
findings.suggested_fix: Wasichana waliinamisha vichwa vyao pamoja na kumsihi Bwana awalinde na kuwasaidia.
findings.translation_quote: Wasichana waliinua vichwa vyao pamoja na kumsihi Bwana awalinde na kuwasaidia.
